_comment: Light-wash denim (Phase08 8.3, RD-P08-5): Denim_Indigo's 3/1 twill with the indigo warp bleached, authored light so a Creator's tint (a 0-1 multiply) reaches the mid and dark washes and other colours, which it cannot do from dark indigo. OPAQUE with a little FUZZ. The colour IS the weave (warp and white weft flecks), so a base-colour texture; its normal and roughness are Denim_Twill's (the same weave).
name: Denim_LightWash_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: A light (bleached) wash: the warp's indigo at linear ~0.22, 0.33, 0.55, lighter towards ~0.32, 0.45, 0.66 where the yarn core shows (thread-scale only), over Denim_Indigo's undyed weft. Everything else is Denim_Indigo's: 32 x 32 threads per cm, IOR 1.53 (cellulose), fuzz 0.3.
